proposal:
STATUS. Hand-derived, unexecuted, unimplemented extension (FFQ). Not polynomial SAT and no universal growth bound: it enlarges a tractable family and proves where that family stops. The fixture probes v2 only. The watcher handoff has no bearing here.

DIAGNOSIS. v2 accepts only pointwise F(x)=G(Bx). One extra clause makes a block odd, kills its stabiliser, and can drop the global W to 0. That is a limit of the certificate type, not evidence of hardness.

MECHANISM FFQ (fibred flat quotient with residue mass). Blocks are (K,S_K). For ANY subspace W of F_2^n let ρ_K=dim π_K(W), Core_K={p∈S_K : p+π_K(W)⊆S_K}, and Res_K=S_K minus Core_K. The split is canonical and polynomial. Core is W-invariant and descends to G_0 on F_2^n/W. Define Φ(W)=Σ_K |Res_K|·2^(−ρ_K).

Lemma F (hand proof). If Φ(W)<1, every x⊨Core has w∈W with x+w⊨F, so SAT(F)⇔SAT(G_0). For uniform w each residue point is hit with probability 0 or 2^(−ρ_K); apply the union bound. Conditional expectations give a deterministic lift using rank computations only. Res=∅ is v2's exact quotient; W=F_2^n is the classical Σ2^(−|C|)<1.

Sharpness (hand proof). At mass exactly 1 a fibre is covered iff the active flats are pairwise disjoint. Mass in (1,1+ε) is NP-hard already at W=F_2^n: prefix (z_1),(¬z_1∨z_2),…,(¬z_1∨…∨¬z_(t−1)∨z_t) and append ¬z_1∨…∨¬z_t to every clause of an arbitrary CNF. So 1 is the exact frontier of the union-bound argument.

Lemma I (hand proof). If W→⊕_{Res_K≠∅} π_K(W) is surjective, SAT(F)⇔SAT(G_0) for any Φ: pick an unforbidden point in each selected local coset, then solve one linear system.

CERTIFICATE. Pointwise equality is replaced by a retraction certificate: ∀x F(x)⇒G_0(Bx), and ∀y G_0(y)⇒F(ℓ(y)) with ℓ nonlinear. Same 2^n+2^r exhaustive budget. CompressionSoundness.lean does not cover this rule; v2's checker would rightly reject FFQ quotients.

INCOMPATIBLE FORMS. W=∩_K π_K^(−1)(W_K) is canonical, so G_0 exists as forbidden flats over any basis of Ann(W) with no greedy choice. v2 additionally needs one basis adapted to every block space V_K. From memory (Polishchuk–Positselski, Quadratic Algebras, Ch.1 §7; re-verify), such a basis exists iff the V_K generate a distributive lattice. Necessary test: dim((V_i+V_j)∩V_k)=dim(V_i∩V_k+V_j∩V_k) for all triples. A violation means no ranking can pass, so the skip is structural rather than greedy.

DISCOVERY (separate from v2's bounded greedy). (a) Margin regime: Lemma N of 00053 recovers W_K when a block has fewer than |W_K|/2 defects; the global W is then linear algebra. Polynomial, uncapped, incomplete. (b) Width ≤c: Φ<1 forces fewer than 2^c residue points, so enumerate residue blocks and their local subspaces in m^(2^c−1)·2^O(c²·2^c)·poly. Complete, polynomial for fixed c, impractical. (c) Unbounded width: open.

TOTAL WORK. Generalised blocks (linear map A_K, point set) are closed under quotienting, so descent iterates at most n rounds, each roughly Σ|S_K|²|K|+n³ bit operations in regime (a). This bounds FFQ's own work only. The residual solver stays unbounded.

INDEPENDENT-TEST PREDICTIONS (FFQ, unexecuted).
P1, fixture: W=span{011011011011,110110110110} on x1..x12, ρ=2, Φ=3/4. G_0 is, up to basis, the 10-variable 9-binary-clause quotient from the 00053 receipt. The retraction check passes and the pointwise check fails.
P2, 96+6 control: if its blocks are 6-variable with |W_K|=16 (inferred, unverified), Φ=6/16 and G_0 is auto00007's quotient. Root solve against measured peak 9. Here failed compression did cause a harder trace.
P3, 36+9 control: if ρ=2 then Φ=9/4 and Lemma F must not fire. Deployed peak is already 0: failed compression, no harder trace.
P4, auto00008: some triple violates the distributivity test. Low confidence; I have not seen the formula.

FIXTURE. Chain-36 plus three extras. v2: blocks 1, 5 and 9 have five points, hence trivial stabilisers; their spaces contain x1..x12, rank 12, no reduction, skip. Deployed DP: in every block all forbidden points agree on the first and last coordinate, so eliminating an end variable gives only tautological resolvents. Nine eliminations, peak 0, SAT witness 000111000111.
missing_theorem: T90 (complete discovery for the Φ<1 class). Give an algorithm, polynomial in n and |F| with exponent independent of block width, that returns a nonzero W with Φ(W)<1 whenever one exists, on generalised-block inputs. Otherwise prove the existence question NP-hard for unbounded width. Known by hand only: dim W=1 is polynomial (at most one unpaired point, so one guessed local difference plus a linear system); the margin regime; width c in m^(2^c). Before T90, Lemma F, Lemma I and the retraction rule need a Lean proof for general n. T89 stays open for Φ≥1.
self_attack:
1. This is still family detection. A generic formula has no W with Φ<1, FFQ skips, and nothing is gained.
2. The sharpness result cuts against me. The budget is total mass below 1: three extras at ρ=2. The 36+9 control lies outside. Refining to per-fibre load turns it into a cardinality-constrained search on the quotient, which I do not bound.
3. Lemma F gives equisatisfiability only. Model counts and the fibre bijection are lost, and anything downstream that assumes F(x)=G(Bx) breaks.
4. Lemma N needs margin. One defect on a |W_K|=2 block, or defects that create a larger false stabiliser, defeat discovery.
5. A flat-valued G_0 needs a solver that reads XOR-clauses. CNF expansion costs up to 2^(weight−1) per parity literal. On Tseitin-like dependent forms I have not analysed the deployed solver.
6. P2 and P4 rest on inferred structure of formulas I have not seen. The distributivity citation is from memory.
7. The fixture peak assumes ELIM picks end variables (lowest occurrence product). I did not check interior-first orders.

delta_from_prior:
00053 (AFC) stored flats with no chart and left defect transfer (T89) open.

New here:
(1) A canonical core/residue split for any W, with the mass invariant Φ.
(2) Lemmas F and I: two hand-proved regimes where defects cost nothing. This answers T89 only for Φ<1 or independent residues.
(3) Correction to 00053: T89's first alternative is too strong as stated. With F_0=∅ it would give polynomial flat counts for every CNF, which would imply NP=coNP. It must be restricted, for example to τ=O(log n).
(4) A retraction certificate in place of pointwise equality.
(5) A distributive-lattice criterion separating structural from greedy incompatibility.
(6) Explicit discovery costs, including the m^(2^c) complete search.
